lead: Four arrangements, all of them settled against a monthly invoice rather than at a checkout. Nothing is charged before the month it covers has ended.
note: Direct debit needs a SEPA mandate, which we send with the first invoice. Public bodies and charitable providers are invoiced on account with 30-day terms as standard. We never hold your card details ourselves — card payments run through our payment provider, and we see only the last four digits on the statement.
